create_mfg_dqn_agents: create DQN agents trained on an MFG game against a crowd following a uniform policy
run_mfg_training: run DQN training on MFG predator-prey game with configurable episodes and evaluation frequency
build_mfg_environment: build MFG environments for each player using DistributionPolicy and UniformRandomPolicy
evaluate_nash_conv: evaluate Nash Conv best response values against uniform policy at regular intervals
save_load_checkpoints: save and load DQN agent neural network weights from a checkpoint directory
